review_markdown:
| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--sans` began with `ui-sans-serif,system-ui`, which rendered as monospace on Linux | Local stack: Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Noto Sans, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif | Proportional body text without downloads |
| 13 ungated `:hover` rules across five stylesheets | Each rule removed from the base and restated inside `@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)` in the same file | Hover no longer sticks after a tap, and primary colors stay intact |
| Combined `:hover,[aria-pressed]` selectors | Pressed state kept in the base; hover gated; lab hover skips pressed and primary buttons | Selected states still read as selected |
| No press feedback | `scale(.97)` for 120ms on `:active`, only under `prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference` | Taps confirm immediately |
| Keyboard focus could pick up the press animation | `:focus-visible` sets `transition:none; transform:none`; the outline stays | Focus shows instantly with no motion |
| Selects at 12 to 13px on phones | 16px | Prevents iOS zoom on focus |
| Tiny Tune Play sat below the presets and help text | Transport bar sticks to the bottom of the screen on phones, with a safe-area inset | Play is within thumb reach |
| Tall phone mastheads and headers | Tighter page-header padding, action margins and masthead height | First controls appear sooner |
| Dense menu cards | 27px titles, metadata separated by a rule, links pushed to the card bottom | Clearer hierarchy and alignment |
| Long body lines | `max-width:62ch` on intro and guide text | More comfortable line length |

coverage.changes: Proportional local font stack, hover gated by capability, scale press feedback without motion on keyboard focus, touch-action, 44px copy buttons, readable line widths, tighter phone headers
Smaller card titles, metadata separated by a rule, links aligned to the card bottom, 16px filter selects
Open demo comes first and spans full width on phones, mode tabs fill the row, text limited to 68ch
Auto-width link column, larger tabs, compact phone rows
Timeline hover gated, 16px phone selects, 44px scene buttons
Action and check hover gated while pressed states stay visible, 44px options
Lab hover skips pressed and primary buttons, shorter phone masthead, tighter panels
Sticky transport bar keeps Play at the bottom of phone screens with a safe-area inset, static in print, 16px select
